items.source: The id of the endpoint (must follow EndpointId rules).
items.translation: 端点的 ID（必须遵循EndpointId规则）。

items.source: Level of access to the endpoint that is permitted by default.
items.translation: 默认允许访问该端点的权限级别。

items.source: Most @Endpoint classes will declare one or more @ReadOperation, @WriteOperation, @DeleteOperation annotated methods which will be automatically adapted to the exposing technology (JMX, Spring MVC, Spring WebFlux, Jersey etc.).
items.translation: 大多数 `@Endpoint` 类会声明一个或多个带有 `@ReadOperation`、`@WriteOperation` 或 `@DeleteOperation` 注解的方法，这些方法将自动适配到暴露技术（如 JMX、Spring MVC、Spring WebFlux、Jersey 等）。

items.source: @Endpoint represents the lowest common denominator for endpoints and intentionally limits the sorts of operation methods that may be defined in order to support the broadest possible range of exposure technologies. If you need deeper support for a specific technology you can either write an endpoint that is filtered to a certain technology, or provide extension for the broader endpoint.
items.translation: @Endpoint 代表了端点的最小公分母，并有意限制了可定义的操作方法类型，以支持尽可能广泛的暴露技术。如果您需要针对特定技术的更深层次支持，您可以编写一个针对该技术进行filtered的端点，或者为更通用的端点提供extension。
